answer_1.quote: This problem is particularly evident in complex tasks such as open-ended text generation, conversational dialogue, and creative writing, where human judgment is paramount.
answer_1.outputs: LLM-generated responses to prompts (open-ended, dialogue, or creative generation tasks)

answer_4.quote: A widely recognized example is Chatbot Arena, which directly compares models through "head-to-head combat," where users vote between responses from two competing models. ... presenting human judges with pairs of model outputs and asking them to select the better one.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges are shown two model outputs for the same prompt and asked to choose which one is better.
